versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x08, the Dcm module shall obtain the DTCAndSeverityRecords by repeatedly call- ing Dem_GetNextFilteredDTCAndSeverity() after having configured the filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.13.
